privacy.sub: How this website uses the details you choose to share.
privacy.s1b: Contact details, company information, product requirements and attachments submitted with an enquiry. A hashed connection identifier limits abusive submissions.
privacy.s2b: Details are used to review and respond to enquiries, prepare quotations and coordinate requested commercial discussions. Access is limited to authorised administrators.
privacy.s3b: Records are held with our hosting provider. Data may be processed outside your country. Retention follows business follow-up and record-keeping obligations; you may request specific retention or deletion.
privacy.s4b: Contact motai-01@motaiabrasive.com to request access, correction or deletion. Please do not submit sensitive personal data or confidential files unrelated to your enquiry.
privacy.s5b: The browser stores enquiry-list management data. This site uses Google Analytics (gtag.js) for anonymised usage statistics; Google sets a cookie and processes data under its data-processing terms — you can opt out at https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/3452785. External WhatsApp, map and social links are governed by their own privacy policies.

pfq.specs.a: Share your required dimensions, grit, workpiece, machine and intended finish. Use the documented options where available; other requirements will be reviewed with our team.
pfq.oem.q: How do I request OEM packaging?
pfq.oem.a: Include your branding and packaging requirements in the enquiry. Details will be reviewed and confirmed with your quotation.
pfq.order.q: Does requesting a quote place an order?
pfq.order.a: No. The form starts a wholesale enquiry. Product specifications, availability and commercial terms are confirmed before an order is agreed.
